snippet.title: Death Kitchen Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Death Kitchen is an immersive fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you in many situations. Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.
===========================
